issue_context.title: backup: BACKUP INTO shows up as BACKUP TO in jobs
issue_context.body: The job description doesn't reflect the INTO, or the chosen path for that specific backup, because we copy the `tree.Backup` and fill it manually for redaction and are dropping the INTO. Ditto for RESTORE.

review_comments: `{`BACKUP TABLE foo INTO $1 IN $2},` would be good too
do we not still need this?
node.Subdir will never be nil if node.Nested is true. It'll be set in backup planning as long as node.Nested is true. Is there a case we want to still print `LATEST IN` which i'm missing?
what does this case on line 2130 in sql.y do? https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pull/53139/files#diff-15c44669e939ef2a26ac13bed5a93009R2130

`BACKUP opt_backup_targets INTO LATEST IN string_or_placeholder_opt_list...`

becomes:

`BACKUP INTO 'resolved-LATEST-subdir' IN string_or_placeholder_opt_list...` because of:
```
if b.Nested {
		b.Subdir = tree.NewDString(resolvedSubdir)
}
``` 
in `backupJobDescription()`. Where resolvedSubdir is the `chosenSuffix` in backup planning.

Oh, I think I see what you mean: in the tree.Backup _you_ create in `backupJobDesc` it'll never be nil since we'll resolve latest to a value, but we have to be able to round-trip any AST node to/from SQL, even before planning. I'm pretty sure you want `if node.AppendToLatest { .. else } if node.Subdir != nil { ...}`
got it, wasn't aware we need to be able to round-trip. will change it!
